name: Spinach Ricotta Cannelloni
ingredients: 4 whole-wheat cannelloni tubes or manicotti shells (about 50 g)
Pinch of nutmeg, pepper and salt
steps: Squeeze the spinach dry and mix with the ricotta, tofu, garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fill the uncooked tubes using a spoon or piping bag.
Spread half the passata in a baking dish, lay the tubes on top, and cover with the remaining passata and basil.
Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes; uncover, scatter the mozzarella and bake for 5 minutes more.
note: Mixing tofu with the ricotta raises protein and lowers saturated fat versus an all-ricotta filling.
